original.statement: SuFEx-mediated cyclization occurs chemoselectively at tyrosine residues.

proposed.statement: In the tested 4FSB-GXGY precursors with X=K, T, R or N, incubation in PBS at pH 7.8 produced Tyr-cyclized products 6a–d despite the alternative reactive side chains.
proposed.endpoint: reaction chemoselectivity and isolated macrocyclization yield
proposed.direction: Tyr-selective product formation in this substrate series; no general increase relative to an untreated or alternative-route comparator established

comparator.type: competing side-chain sites within each tested precursor

proposed.scope: 4FSB-functionalized GXGY precursors, C-terminal Tyr, PBS pH 7.8; no extension to arbitrary Tyr-containing peptides

reported_observations.applies_to: products 6a–d collectively; per-product values not reconstructed

reported_observations.evidence: Crude HPLC for the series and additional NMR support for Tyr versus Lys in 6a

required_applicability: Tested GXGY sequence and competing side chain
